snippet.title: Dynasty Divided: A Three Kingdoms Saga | Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
190 AD. The Han dynasty is dying, and twelve warlords want what is left.

Dynasty Divided is a turn-based Three Kingdoms grand strategy game with hex sieges, sworn brothers, duels and officers who hold grudges. English and Simplified Chinese. Single player, no microtransactions.

Early Access on Steam, December 4, 2026.

Music from the game, via OpenGameArt.org: Views From Atop the Jade Kings Throne and RPG - Misty Mountains by HitCtrl (CC-BY 3.0); Liyan by elerya (CC-BY 3.0); Sunrise in the Dynasty by Yottabyte1024 (CC-BY 3.0); other tracks CC0.
